description: This file defines the PrefixStore class, which extends the Store class to add prefix handling capabilities, including key management, extended API support, and underlying store access within the c10d distributed training context in PyTorch.

classes.name: PrefixStore
classes.description: A specialized Store that adds a prefix to keys, enabling namespace-like segregation within the distributed store, and providing extended API operations.

methods.name: PrefixStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PrefixStore with a specified prefix and an underlying store.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this PrefixStore.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with the prefix applied to the key.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Performs a compare-and-swap operation on a key with a prefix.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, considering the prefix.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Atomically adds a value to a key (interpreted as an integer).

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the number of keys stored (with the prefix).

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks the existence or validity of a list of keys.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a set of keys to become available.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the current timeout configuration.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for waiting operations.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to an existing key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keys at once.

methods.name: multiSet
methods.description: Sets multiple keys and values at once.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Indicates support for extended API operations like append and multi operations.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes an element to a queue-like structure.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops an element from a queue-like structure, optionally blocking.

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Returns the length of a queue.

methods.name: getUnderlyingStore
methods.description: Returns the underlying Store object this PrefixStore wraps.

methods.name: getUnderlyingNonPrefixStore
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the base store before layers of PrefixStore wrappers.

methods.name: joinKey
methods.description: Generates a prefixed key.

methods.name: joinKeys
methods.description: Generates a list of prefixed keys.
